chunks: "If you included a thousand people in your hajj, each one of them would have a hajj, without anything being diminished from your hajj."

key_terms.أَشْرَكْتَ: you made others share or participate
key_terms.حَجٌّ: the reward or share of a hajj

ai.seo_question: Can the reward of hajj be shared with others without reducing one's own reward?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches that sharing the reward of hajj with others does not reduce the reward of the one who performs it. The hadith highlights the vastness of divine grace and encourages generosity in intention and spiritual inclusion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2242 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you included a thousand people in your Hajj, each one of them would receive the reward of a complete Hajj without anything being diminished from your own Hajj."
